verdict.rationale: Airweave documents single-endpoint search over synced collections and an agentic search that builds a result set. Nothing in the evidence shows a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block assembled from memories in one call. Search results are an adjacent capability, not the named one, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can retrieve a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block assembled from relevant memories in one call
